messages:
maya: Quick cross-geo scan results for Mistral2-7B (q4_0). Prefill=512 tokens, decode=256 tokens, cold KV (0% hit). Short summary: H100 wins prefill latency and tokens/sec in eu/us, but APAC A100 showed weird thermal spikes that erased some gains. $/1M tokens calculated from instance-hour price and measured throughput.

bench-bot: Raw snapshot table (median numbers, small-run):
```
Region | GPU  | prefill_p50_ms | decode_p50_ms | tokens_per_sec | $/1M_tokens
EU     | H100 | 42             | 5             | 9500           | $3.8
EU     | A100 | 52             | 6             | 8200           | $4.1
US-W  | H100 | 45             | 6             | 9200           | $3.9
APAC  | A100 | 60             | 7             | 7400           | $4.8
```

maya: Notes: these runs had no kernel fallback enabled (forced single-kernel path), single worker per GPU, steady 50 qps injector for 30m. Cost calc = (instance_hour_price / tokens_gen_per_hour) * 1e6.

samir: Nice. Was KV cache cold for all regions? did you try 40-60% kv hit sim?
maya: Cold for these. With 60% kv hit simulated offline, tokens/sec up ~25% across board, $/1M drops ~12% relative for both GPUs, H100 advantage in p50 prefill shrinks to ~6-8 ms.
taylor: Did you test any kernel fallthrough (fast-attn vs fallback) or quant mix (q8x4 vs q4_0)?
maya: Only q4_0 in this pass. No fallthrough. Planning q8x4 + fallthrough matrix next week.

olivia: Any thermal/host issues in APAC H100? you mentioned spikes on A100 only?
maya: Correct — APAC A100 hosts had one sustained thermal throttle during a 10m window, caused p50 to jitter and tokens/sec drop ~12%. H100 APAC hosts looked stable.

samir: Can you paste the run command so I can repro?
maya: Sure:
```
run_bench --model mistral2-7b --quant q4_0 --gpu {a100,h100} --prefill 512 --decode 256 --region eu-west,us-west,apac --qps 50 --duration 1800 --kv_hit 0 --collect latency,tokens,throughput --no-fallback
```

maya: Quick cost example: eu H100 instance price $2.5/hr, measured tokens/hr ~34.2M -> $/1M = (2.5 / 34.2) * 1e6 =~ $3.8. Adjust for avg KV hit to estimate production.

taylor: Cool. Can you add p95/p99 in next dump? also add worker=2 runs to check multi-worker scaling.
maya: Yep planning p95/p99 and worker scaling tomorrow. Will also run q8x4 baseline and attach heatmaps.

olivia: :thumbsup: Thanks for the snapshot, super helpful for capacity planning.
samir: cc @product for SLAs, sounds like APAC capacity needs guardrails.
maya: ack, will follow up with a short doc and recommended per-region sku mix.
